breaking.change: Every game shader now has `hue_rotate(rgb: vec3<f32>, a: f32) -> vec3<f32>` (the colour's hue turned by `a` radians about the grey axis) in scope from the engine's one copy; a shader that declares its own `hue_rotate` no longer compiles.
breaking.fix: Delete your own copy and call the library's, or rename yours.
